Build a ragnar evidence store from Zotero PDFs

Source: R/store.R
crd_store_build.Rd

Ingests the PDFs attached to a Zotero collection — or to an explicit set of citation keys — into a ragnar DuckDB store, chunked, embedded and indexed for both semantic and BM25 retrieval.

Usage

crd_store_build(
  store_path,
  collection = NULL,
  citation_keys = NULL,
  model = "nomic-embed-text",
  zotero_dir = "~/Zotero",
  overwrite = FALSE,
  library = getOption("cred.zotero_library")
)

Arguments

store_path

character(1) path for the .duckdb store to create.

collection

character(1) Zotero collection name, or a parent/child path when the name alone matches more than one. Supply exactly one of collection or citation_keys.

citation_keys

character vector of Better BibTeX citation keys.

model

character(1) Ollama embedding model. Default "nomic-embed-text" — the model the shared stores are built with.

zotero_dir

character(1) Zotero data directory. Default "~/Zotero".

overwrite

logical(1) replace an existing store. Default FALSE.

library

The Zotero library to resolve keys in: "user" for My Library, or a group's name or groupID (as in its URL, zotero.org/groups/<groupID>). Zotero's internal libraryID is not accepted: it differs between machines. Default getOption("cred.zotero_library"); NULL searches every library.

Value

Invisibly, a tibble with one row per ingested file (citation_key, src_path), so a key with several PDFs has several rows; a skipped PDF has none. Prints document and chunk counts.

Details

The embedding model is pinned explicitly on every build. This matters more than it looks: ragnar::embed_ollama() defaults to embeddinggemma, so a store built without pinning is silently incomparable with every other store in the shared corpus while appearing entirely healthy.

Building is expensive and machine-local. Sharing a built store is done out of band; see crd_store_connect() for the retrieval side.

What is ingested. Every live PDF of each item: an appendix, or the other parts of a multi-part report, are searchable too, and each still answers to its item's citation key. Byte-identical copies on one item are ingested once. Trashed items, trashed attachments and trashed collections are never used. Before ingesting, the build lists every item it leaves out and why (trashed, a note, a standalone attachment, no citation key, a citation key shared by several items, no live PDF; for citation_keys, also not found or unresolved), and the items it takes several PDFs from.

Which library. Citation keys and collection names are unique within a Zotero library at best, so both resolve in library. A key found in more than one library, on two live items in one, or only in a library other than library, is left out with a warning. A collection name that matches more than one collection is an error listing each, with its parent/child path. A collection's subcollections are not included.

What cannot be read or embedded. One PDF that cannot be read or embedded does not cost the build. A PDF that markitdown cannot read, such as one whose text carries a NUL byte, is read with pdftools::pdf_text() instead, without markdown headings. A PDF neither can read is skipped, and a warning names it and why. A chunk the embedding model refuses whole, such as a long run of figure glyphs, is split until each part embeds; a part still refused at 64 characters is left out of the embeddings. Both are reported. A failure of the embedding service itself still stops the build and leaves no store: it would cost every PDF still to come, silently, rather than one that is named.

ragnar's own progress output is off, because it does not handle every file name safely. The build says what it will ingest before it starts, and what it ingested, read differently, split or skipped when it ends.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
crd_store_build("data/rag/vca_refs.duckdb", collection = "vca",
                library = "NewGraphEnvironment")

crd_store_build(
  "data/rag/adhoc.duckdb",
  citation_keys = c("hall_etal2007Predictingriver", "beechie_etal2005ClassificationHabitat")
)
} # }
